name: standing-hands-in-pockets
notes: Kept its own alpha (matte peaks at 254, body 99.6 percent opaque). Flatter, lighter rendering than the rest; head turned slightly to screen-left, sullen look. Primary for this pose should be standing-hands-in-pockets-2 (#8): front face, neutral, matches the main style.

name: pointing
notes: Points to screen-left with the right hand, other fist at side. Primary of the pointing pair: first in order, linework identical to #3.

name: pointing-2
notes: Near-duplicate of blond-anime-boy-pointing-confidently (#2); keep #2.

name: reaching-out
notes: Leaning toward the viewer, near hand foreshortened and large; open-mouth grin. Heavier shading than the main set. Purple drop shadow residue under both feet (20072 px).

name: striding
notes: Walking to screen-left, smile. Drop shadow residue under the feet (3294 px).

name: waving
notes: Right hand raised, left hand in pocket. Small motion marks beside the raised hand are kept in the sprite.

name: sitting-cross-legged
notes: Hands clasped between the legs. Drop shadow residue under the body (7804 px).

name: standing-hands-in-pockets-2
notes: Proposed primary for standing-hands-in-pockets: neutral expression, front face, main style. Candidate default pose.

name: standing-arms-crossed
notes: Head turned slightly to screen-left, serious look. Only arms-crossed sprite.

name: standing-hands-on-hips
notes: Primary of the three hands-on-hips sprites (#10, #11, #12): first in order; the three are near-identical.

name: standing-hands-on-hips-2

name: standing-hands-on-hips-3
notes: Near-duplicate of confident-blond-anime-character-on-magenta (#10).

name: kneeling
notes: Kneeling on both knees, fists on thighs. Primary of the kneeling pair (full size). Drop shadow residue (10862 px).

name: crying

name: running

name: standing-hands-behind-back

name: laughing

name: shrugging
notes: Palms up, mouth slightly open.

name: shocked
notes: Hands up, wide eyes, mouth open. Primary of the shocked group (#19, #20, #23, #24, #25, #26, #30): full size, no marks.

name: shocked-2

name: sad
notes: Head down, arms hanging, frown; eyes open looking down. Right panel of the two-panel sheet, drawn smaller. Primary of the sad pair because it is the larger drawing of the two panel versions; #31 is the alternative.

name: looking-back
notes: Body turned away and angled to screen-right, head turned over the left shoulder toward the viewer, open smile. Drop shadow residue (6072 px).
